  (unless (and (integer? tokens) (>= tokens 0))
    (error 'record_usage "tokens must be a non-negative integer"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [k (string->symbol key)]
         [usage-h (hash-ref s 'usage (hasheq))]
         [calls (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [total (+ (hash-ref usage-h k 0) tokens)])
    (set-state! (hash-set (hash-set s 'usage (hash-set usage-h k total))
                          'calls (append calls (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens)))))
    total))

Now prices: set_price(model, cents_per_1k_tokens) sets a model's price and returns it. cost(key) is what that key has spent in dollars, rounded to cents. A model without a price costs nothing.

(define (price_of model prices)
  (hash-ref prices (string->symbol model) 0))

(define (set_price model cents_per_1k_tokens)
  (unless (and (real? cents_per_1k_tokens) (>= cents_per_1k_tokens 0))
    (error 'set_price "price must be a non-negative number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [ps (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'prices (hash-set ps (string->symbol model) cents_per_1k_tokens)))
    cents_per_1k_tokens))

(define (cost key)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [ps (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))]
         [calls (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [cents (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c calls])
                  (if (equal? (hash-ref c 'key) key)
                      (+ t (/ (* (hash-ref c 'tokens 0) (price_of (hash-ref c 'model "") ps)) 1000))
                      t))])
    (/ (floor (+ cents (/ 1 2))) 100)))

Rate limits: set_quota(key, tokens) caps a key's total tokens and returns the quota; it throws if the key has already used more. record_usage must throw if the call would take the key over its quota. Keys without a quota are unlimited.

(define (quota_for key quotas)
  (hash-ref quotas (string->symbol key) 'null))

(define (set_quota key tokens)
  (unless (and (integer? tokens) (>= tokens 0))
    (error 'set_quota "quota must be a non-negative integer"))
  (when (> (usage key) tokens)
    (error 'set_quota "key has already used more than this quota"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [qs (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'quotas (hash-set qs (string->symbol key) tokens)))
    tokens))

(define (tokens_for_key key calls)
  (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c calls])
    (if (equal? (hash-ref c 'key) key) (+ t (hash-ref c 'tokens 0)) t)))

(define (usage key)
  (tokens_for_key key (hash-ref (get-state) 'calls '())))

(define (record_usage key model tokens)
  (unless (and (integer? tokens) (>= tokens 0))
    (error 'record_usage "tokens must be a non-negative integer"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [q (quota_for key (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq)))]
         [calls (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [used (tokens_for_key key calls)])
    (when (and (not (eq? q 'null)) (> (+ used tokens) q))
      (error 'record_usage "call would exceed the key's quota"))
    (let ([calls (append calls (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens)))])
      (set-state! (hash-set s 'calls calls))
      (tokens_for_key key calls))))

Who spends the most? top_spender() returns the key with the highest cost; ties go to the alphabetically first key; null when nothing is recorded.

(define (top_spender)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [calls (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [keys (remove-duplicates (for/list ([c calls]) (hash-ref c 'key)))]
         [pairs (for/list ([k keys]) (cons k (cost k)))]
         [sorted (sort pairs (lambda (a b)
                               (if (= (cdr a) (cdr b))
                                   (string<? (car a) (car b))
                                   (> (cdr a) (cdr b)))))])
    (if (null? sorted) 'null (car (car sorted)))))
